name: Search with no results (golden)
description: Opens the More tab, types a query that matches no product into the 'Search products' field, dismisses the keyboard and checks the empty-state message, by driving the shipped mauto CLI. Its normalized result is compared against golden/golden_search_empty.result.json. Known to fail on the default engine until #251 is fixed: the TextField label is dropped, so 'Search products' cannot be resolved (see golden/known-failures.json).

steps.description: Wait for the Home app-bar title, which confirms the app launched and rendered
Type a query no product name contains
Dismiss the keyboard so the results area is fully on screen

assertions.description: The empty-state message is shown for a query with no matches
The rest of the More screen is still rendered after the search
